items.text: nahi yeh galat number hai
maine kuch liya hi nahi
yeh mera number nahi hai

items.context: kaun bol raha hai please bataye?
items.text: incorrect number
wrong person

items.context: kya aapne loan liya tha hamare se?
items.text: maine loan liya hi nahi
yeh account mujhe belong nahi karta hai
maine kabhi aapke yahan se loan nahi liya
galat number dial kiya lagta hai aapne bhai
main kisi aur se baat kar raha tha shayad
meri details kisi aur ke saath confuse ho rahi hain
aap jo bol rahe ho mera naam nahi hai usme
aapko jis se baat karni hai wo main nahi hoon

items.context: kya aap apna loan account number confirm kar sakte hain?
items.text: main us vyakti ko jaanta hi nahi jiske baare mein aap baat kar rahe hain

items.context: aapka naam aur address kya hai?
items.text: mere pass aapke naam ka koi loan account registered nahi hai

items.context: aapko call kyun aayi hai yeh batayein kya hua?
items.text: kuch samajh nahi aa raha mujhe yeh call kyu aayi hai

items.context: kya aapko hamse loan payment ke liye call aayi hai?
items.text: kya aapne kisi aur number par call kiya hai ya galti se humse connect ho gaye hain?

items.context: kya ye number aapka registered mobile number hai?
items.text: yeh number mera nahi lagta mujhe laga galat call hui hai
main apne naam se koi loan nahi liya hu to ye jo call aa rahi hai wo galti se to nahi hai
mera naam aur address apne paas check kar lo kyunki shayad kisi aur ke details aapke paas hongi
main yahan delhi me rehta hu aur mera koi relation nahi hai jiske liye aapko call kar rahe hain

items.context: kya aap confirm kar sakte hain ki yeh aapka account hai jiska payment due hai?
items.text: aapne jo mujhe call kiya hai mujhe nahi lagta ki main wahi aadmi hoon jiska loan balance aapne check kiya hai

items.context: kya aapka naam hamare records ke according loan default list me hai?
items.text: main ye call kisi aur number pe expect nahi kar raha tha kyunki mera naam uss list me nahi hona chahiye tha

items.context: aapko lagta hai ki yeh number galat hai ya phir hamari information galat hai?
items.text: ho sakta hai kisi aur ne mera number galti se de diya ho ya phone list me confusion ho jiske wajah se aap call kar rahe hain

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: wrong_person - says the agent has the wrong person or number
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
